name: CodePulse API
short_description: Pay-per-call free web, scraper, temporary mailboxes, domain, and package intelligence utilities for AI agents.
description: CodePulse API exposes narrow, machine-readable free web, scraper, temporary mailboxes, domain, and package intelligence utilities AI agents can call instead of guessing: WHOIS registries, temporary mailboxes, temp phone SMS scrapers, sitemaps, RSS feeds, NPM/PyPI registries, secret scans, HaveIBeenPwned checks, PDF parsing, OCR scanners, QR builders. Paid per request with x402 on Base USDC.
